paper_metadata.title: Neural networks for estimating Macro Asset Pricing model in football clubs
paper_metadata.venue: Intelligent Systems in Accounting, Finance and Management

summary: Estimates a Macro Asset Pricing (MAP) model for listed European football clubs decomposing log price-dividend ratio into long-run growth, long-run volatility, surplus consumption (habit) and a permanent residual. Three non-linear estimators benchmarked: Deep Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network (DRCNN), Deep Neural Decision Trees (DNDT), and a quantum-inspired Quantum Neural Network (QNN). Monthly data from STOXX Europe Football Index plus Manchester United (Bureau van Dijk Amadeus) and Eurostat harmonized consumption, 2011-2020, 70/30 train/test split. QNN achieves highest precision: 93.97% training accuracy / 90.90% test accuracy, RMSE 0.52/0.61 (train/test), R^2=62.27% in 'Including all variables' specification. DNDT second (90.63%/86.74% acc, RMSE 0.63/0.81). DRCNN weakest of the three (79.71%/74.95% acc, RMSE 0.95/1.13). Residual component accounts for ~40% of price-dividend variance; long-term risks and habit have smaller but non-trivial shares. QNN here is a quantum-inspired classical simulation (no real quantum hardware or gate-based simulator used).

experiments.description: Quantum Neural Network (quantum-inspired hybrid neural architecture) used to estimate the Macro Asset Pricing model for listed football clubs. Monthly data from STOXX Europe Football + Manchester United and Eurostat consumption 2011-2020; 70/30 train/test split. Learning rate 0.1. Evaluates three specifications (Including all variables, Only long-run volatility, robustness variants).

algorithm.variant: Quantum Neural Network (QNN) - quantum-inspired hybrid neural architecture; not executed on gate-based QPU or simulator
algorithm.ansatz: Quantum-inspired neuron weight update: gamma_ij' = gamma_ij + eta * Delta_theta_ij (Jeswal & Chakraverty 2019; Verdon et al. 2019 inspired)
algorithm.optimizer: stochastic gradient descent with learning rate eta=0.1

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Inputs: monthly consumption growth (Eurostat harmonized), dividend growth, and log price-dividend ratio from STOXX Europe Football Index + Manchester United. MAP state variables: long-run growth xt (AR(1)), long-run volatility sigma_t (log-vol AR(1)), surplus consumption / habit s_t, and permanent residual e_t; log price-dividend pdt = mu_pd + Ax*xt + Av*sigma2_t + As*st + Ae*et.
problem_formulation.constraints: Priors: long-term growth and surplus consumption coefficients constrained positive; long-term volatility coefficient negative; volatility of residuals fixed at 1; s set to log(0.06).
